dedupe_keys.name: tailte eireann high value dataset ways roads and paths and rail network

description: Tailte Éireann (Ireland's land registry, valuation and mapping agency) publishes the road, path and railway layers of the national mapping data as a European high value dataset: Ways (all drivable and walkable roads and paths, with polygon geometry for all classes from motorway to fifth class), Way GDF2 centrelines, Way Points at ends and junctions, Rail Network Segments (GDF1 for all railways, GDF2 for mainline railways) and Rail Points, which the description says follow European network standards derived from centreline data. Coverage: the whole Republic of Ireland; last modified on 2026-01-09 according to the portal. Format and access: CSV, GeoJSON, KML, Excel, file geodatabase and GeoPackage downloads plus an ArcGIS REST feature service, without registration from the Tailte Éireann open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the layers were not opened, so attributes such as road class, speed or capacity were not read; some lower-class roads may lack polygon geometry. Simulation uses: road and rail network topology for network-flow, accessibility and cascading-failure models, and routing graphs for emergency response. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
